question: What is the rank of the book with the smallest number of pages?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "books" AS SELECT "book_id" AS "book_id", "title" AS "title", "type" AS "type", "pages" AS "pages", "chapters" AS "chapters", "audio" AS "audio", "release" AS "release" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "reviews" AS SELECT "review_id" AS "review_id", "book_id" AS "book_id", "rating" AS "rating", "rim" AS "rim", "rk" AS "rk" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH min_pages AS (
  SELECT MIN(pages) AS min_pages FROM books
)
SELECT r.rk AS rank_of_smallest_pages_book
FROM books b
JOIN reviews r ON r.book_id = b.book_id
JOIN min_pages m ON b.pages = m.min_pages
ORDER BY r.rk
LIMIT 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 16 AS rank_of_smallest_pages_book
